Identify the antecedent of the following conditional proposition: The Bees win their first
game only if either the Aardvarks or the Chipmunks do not win their first games.

options.A: The Bees do not win their first game.
options.B: Both the Aardvarks and the Chipmunks do not win their first games.
options.C: The Chipmunks do not win their first game.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The Bees do not win their first game.
